# Accessibility comparison

Accessibility carries the single largest weight in the scorecard, 18 of 100, because it is the requirement most often deferred and least often recoverable late. A label is not an accessible interface and a widget tree is not a screen-reader session: this matrix passes only when Orca, or an equivalent assistive technology, actually navigates the Bunny shell.

| Gate | Mandatory | Smithay | libmutter |
|---|---|---|---|
| real Orca session | **yes** | `NOT_RUN` | `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |
| AT-SPI navigation | no | `NOT_RUN` | `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |

Recorded reasons:

- compositor/bunny-mutter-v4 has no downstream shell implementation yet, so there is nothing to measure.
- not executed in V4. The V3 prototype is the starting point; no V4 measurement has been made.

## Status

No gate in this matrix has been measured. Nothing here supports a framework selection, and nothing here may be cited as qualification evidence.
